decisions.reason: Connects host process and its tool worker to the npm-replaced install tree; host dies at linkStuff (16:41:31), GUI loss and unrecorded tool result explained; preserves unknown outcome and frames the crash as a signature, not a network flake, without universal-platform claims.

Explains shim layer vs package content: dsh/dsh.cmd missing, dsh.ps1 stale, so content presence proves nothing; ties the manually swapped tree to missing shims and rejects hand-copying/shim surgery in favor of formal reinstall.

Records the external pinned rc.1 install regenerating all shims with dsh --version verification, plus source checkout aligned to the rc.1 tag; distinguishes the recorded repair from its proposed real-machine verification.

Recognizes the agent runs on the upgrade target and must hand off the external procedure, never execute it; full host stop before the pinned install, then restart, hard refresh, verify; classifies stop-first/pinning as standing rules and self-host refusal as the incident-specific rule; a dependent worker shell is implicitly excluded by 'external terminal, not a child of the host'.

Guard compares install target path to the running runtime's module path and refuses/downgrades to external handoff; uses the 252-file version-only alpha.5→rc.1 diff to rule out re-migration; checks shims, version markers after hard refresh, plugin loading, and optional backup cleanup only after stable rc.1; no code changes demanded.

caps.reason: Final advice is handoff plus external pinned install after stopping the host; in-session execution appears only as the rejected error.
Final fix is the formal external pinned install; manual swaps are cited only as rejected options.
